SELECT customer_id, full_name, joined_at
FROM customers
WHERE country = 'Morocco' AND joined_at < '2026-01-01'
ORDER BY joined_at, customer_id;
SELECT order_id, customer_id FROM orders WHERE completed_at IS NULL ORDER BY order_id;

SELECT product_id, product_name, list_price_cents
FROM products
WHERE is_active = 0 AND list_price_cents > 10000
ORDER BY list_price_cents DESC, product_id;
SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE ordered_at < '2026-04-01'
SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers WHERE country = 'France' AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY city ASC

SELECT product_id, product_name, list_price_cents
FROM products
WHERE is_active = 1 AND list_price_cents BETWEEN 3000 AND 7000
ORDER BY product_name, product_id;

SELECT order_id, completed_at
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
ORDER BY completed_at DESC, order_id DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

SELECT payment_id, order_id, amount_cents
FROM payments
WHERE status = 'failed' AND attempted_at IS NOT NULL AND amount_cents > 20000
ORDER BY amount_cents DESC, payment_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE quantity = 5
SELECT return_id, order_id, quantity FROM returns WHERE reason = 'damaged' ORDER BY return_id;
SELECT MIN(joined_at) AS earliest_date, MAX(joined_at) AS latest_date FROM customers WHERE is_active = 0

SELECT order_id, ordered_at
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'placed'
  AND cancelled_at IS NULL
ORDER BY ordered_at ASC, order_id ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.full_name,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
    customers c
LEFT JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id, c.full_name
ORDER BY 
    c.customer_id;

SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS active_product_count
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE p.is_active = 1
GROUP BY c.category_name
ORDER BY active_product_count DESC, c.category_name ASC;

SELECT 
    o.order_id,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) AS order_total_cents
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE 
    o.status = 'completed' AND 
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.ordered_at) = '2026-08'
GROUP BY 
    o.order_id
ORDER BY 
    order_total_cents DESC, o.order_id;

SELECT c.country, COUNT(o.order_id) AS completed_order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND c.is_active = 1
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 5
ORDER BY order_count DESC, p.product_id;

SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(oi.line_no) AS line_count
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.category_name
ORDER BY line_count DESC, c.category_name ASC;

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_order_count
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'cancelled'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

SELECT 
    o.status,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) AS total_units
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE 
    o.status IN ('placed', 'completed', 'cancelled')
GROUP BY 
    o.status
ORDER BY 
    o.status;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.city = 'Sfax'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 2
ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_id;

SELECT c.city, COUNT(p.payment_id) AS failed_attempt_count
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE p.status = 'failed'
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY failed_attempt_count DESC, c.city;

SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.full_name,
    COUNT(p.payment_id) AS successful_payment_count
FROM 
    customers c
LEFT JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN 
    payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id AND p.status = 'successful'
WHERE 
    c.is_active = 1
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id, c.full_name
ORDER BY 
    c.customer_id;

SELECT c.category_name, SUM(ri.quantity) AS returned_units
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN returns r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE r.status = 'returned'
GROUP BY c.category_name
HAVING COUNT(r.return_id) > 0
ORDER BY returned_units DESC, c.category_name ASC;

SELECT 
    r.reason,
    COUNT(*) AS partial_return_count
FROM 
    returns r
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id AND r.line_no = oi.line_no
WHERE 
    r.quantity < oi.quantity
GROUP BY 
    r.reason
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY 
    reason;

SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS product_count
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY o.order_id
HAVING product_count >= 4
ORDER BY o.order_id;

SELECT c.country, AVG(oi.quantity) AS average_quantity
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND c.is_active = 1
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.full_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'completed' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS completed_units
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE 
    o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id, c.full_name
ORDER BY 
    c.customer_id;

SELECT 
    c.category_name,
    MAX(p.list_price_cents) AS highest_price_cents,
    COUNT(*) AS active_product_count
FROM 
    categories c
JOIN 
    products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE 
    p.is_active = 1
GROUP BY 
    c.category_name
ORDER BY 
    c.category_name;

SELECT 
    o.status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY 
    o.status
ORDER BY 
    o.status;

SELECT c.city, COUNT(r.return_id) AS return_count
FROM returns r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY return_count DESC, c.city;

SELECT 
    o.status AS order_status,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'successful' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count
FROM 
    orders o
LEFT JOIN 
    payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY 
    o.status
ORDER BY 
    order_status;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM orders o2
    WHERE o2.customer_id = c.customer_id
      AND o2.status = 'completed'
  )
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name
ORDER BY c.customer_id;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name
FROM customers c
JOIN (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY customer_id
) oc ON c.customer_id = oc.customer_id
JOIN (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY customer_id
) oc2 ON c.customer_id = oc2.customer_id
WHERE oc.completed_orders > oc2.cancelled_orders
ORDER BY c.customer_id;

SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.country) AS country_count
FROM 
    products p
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE 
    o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
    p.product_id, p.product_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.country) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    country_count DESC,
    p.product_id;

SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.full_name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id AND p.status = 'successful'
WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.attempted_at IS NOT NULL
INTERSECT
SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.full_name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id AND p.status = 'successful'
WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.attempted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY c.customer_id;

SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.full_name,
    MAX(o.total) AS largest_completed_order_total_cents
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE 
    o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id, c.full_name
ORDER BY 
    largest_completed_order_total_cents DESC,
    c.customer_id;

SELECT o.order_id
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id AND oi.line_no = r.line_no
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND oi.quantity > 0
GROUP BY o.order_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN r.returned_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
  AND SUM(CASE WHEN r.returned_at IS NOT NULL THEN oi.quantity - r.quantity ELSE 0 END) = 0
ORDER BY o.order_id;

SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.full_name,
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN o.status = 'completed' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS total_spent_cents
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE 
    o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id, c.full_name
ORDER BY 
    total_spent_cents DESC,
    c.customer_id ASC;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 2 AND 
       SUM(CASE WHEN COUNT(order_items.line_no) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1;

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.order_id IN (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.is_active = 1
)
AND oi.order_id NOT IN (
    SELECT r.order_id
    FROM returns r
);

SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.full_name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
ORDER BY o.ordered_at ASC, o.order_id ASC;

SELECT 
    o.order_id,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) AS order_total_cents,
    SUM(p.amount_cents) AS paid_cents
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN 
    payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id AND p.status = 'successful'
WHERE 
    o.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled')
GROUP BY 
    o.order_id
HAVING 
    SUM(p.amount_cents) < SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents)
ORDER BY 
    o.order_id;

SELECT 
    c.category_name,
    SUM(r.quantity) AS returned_units,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS bought_units,
    (SUM(r.quantity) * 1.0 / SUM(oi.quantity)) AS return_ratio
FROM 
    categories c
JOIN 
    products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
LEFT JOIN 
    order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN 
    returns r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id AND oi.line_no = r.line_no
WHERE 
    o.status = 'completed' AND o.is_active = 1
GROUP BY 
    c.category_name, c.category_id
ORDER BY 
    return_ratio DESC,
    c.category_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    c.country,
    c.customer_id,
    c.full_name,
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN o.status = 'completed' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS total_spent_cents
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE 
    o.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled')
GROUP BY 
    c.country, c.customer_id, c.full_name
ORDER BY 
    c.country, total_spent_cents DESC, c.customer_id ASC;

SELECT o.order_id
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.is_active = 0
GROUP BY o.order_id
HAVING COUNT(oi.line_no) = SUM(CASE WHEN p.is_active = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
ORDER BY o.order_id;

SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    p.product_id
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id, p.product_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 2
INTERSECT
SELECT 
    r.customer_id,
    r.product_id
FROM 
    returns r
JOIN 
    orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE 
    o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
    r.customer_id, r.product_id;

SELECT 
    c.category_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'completed' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END) AS completed_cents,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_cents
FROM 
    categories c
JOIN 
    products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN 
    orders o ON p.product_id = oi.product_id AND o.order_id = oi.order_id
LEFT JOIN 
    returns r ON o.order_id = r.order_id AND oi.line_no = r.line_no
WHERE 
    o.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled')
GROUP BY 
    c.category_name, c.category_id
ORDER BY 
    completed_cents - cancelled_cents DESC,
    category_id ASC
LIMIT 1;
